skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic financial services of commercial banks, including deposit services, credit services, and fee-based services.
Analyze the functions of banks and key financial reports.
Understand various types of deposits in banks, pricing of deposits, deposit insurance, and management through interest rates and terms.
Understand credit services such as loan forms, interest rate determination for loans, bank lending processes, etc.
Understand fee-based services of banks such as payments, foreign exchange trading, agency services, investment advisory, fund management, etc.
Interpret the meaning and usage of financial reports of banks and other financial companies, and items on the balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement, and off-balance sheet items.
Prepare research topics, present and debate on recent emerging issues in banking business to understand industry practices and regulations.
Apply learned skills to use commercial banking services effectively and appropriately.
Work collaboratively in groups to prepare presentations and debates on selected topics in finance and banking.
